item.text: The screen is currently only a title/file form. The domain and README define the missing behavior: 1-based active stop ordering with history retained, reasons for changes to started unfinished stops, store-scoped upload prefill, and slot bounds relative to notification and upcoming appointments. I’m shaping the screen around these contracts and adding focused tests for the scheduling logic.
